proof_body:
by
  intro x y hx hy
  rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, div_eq_div_iff hx hy]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hs : Real.sin (x - y) = 0 := by
      rw [Real.sin_sub]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Real.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp hs
    exact ⟨n, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    have hs : Real.sin (x - y) = 0 := by
      rw [Real.sin_eq_zero_iff]
      exact ⟨n, by linarith⟩
    rw [Real.sin_sub] at hs
    linarith
target_source: ∀ x y : ℝ, Real.cos x ≠ 0 → Real.cos y ≠ 0 → (Real.tan x = Real.tan y ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, x = y + n * Real.pi)
